clomiphene.definition: n a fertility drug (trade name Clomid) that is used to stimulate ovulation and that has been associated with multiple births
clomiphene.translation: n. 克罗米酚,舒经酚(一种合成的助生育药)

clomipramine.translation: [化] 氯米帕明; 氯丙咪嗪

clomping.translation: v. 重踏着走( clomp的现在分词 )

clomps.translation: v. 重踏着走( clomp的第三人称单数 )

clompy.translation:
clompy (comparative more clompy, superlative most clompy)
(informal, of shoes etc.) Of a heavy kind that might make clomping noises; stompy.
